necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 for diagnosis codes I47.1, G45.9, and R42.
